execution_phases: phase_a_real_data_intake: download/verify approved covariates, surveillance exports, sequence bodies, and host trapping files into DVC boundaries
phase_b_schema_qc: validate fields, licenses, CRS, dates, taxonomies, effort, and privacy constraints
phase_c_pilot_descriptive_outputs: produce only descriptive diagnostics and publication-style figure templates
phase_d_model_gate_review: approve or skip each model module based on gate evidence
phase_e_model_execution: run only modules with passed gates and pre-registered metrics
phase_f_publication_figure_closeout: export vector/raster figures with captions, provenance, uncertainty, and limitations

figure_specs.caption_must_state: whether figure is suitability, risk, or record availability; no causal language without causal design
figure_specs.format: PDF/SVG vector plus 600-dpi TIFF/PNG raster export
figure_specs.quality_requirements: colorblind-safe palette, CRS/projection label, scale bar where geographic, uncertainty panel, data DOI/provenance in caption

figure_specs.caption_must_state: GBIF occurrence density is not abundance; abundance requires effort-screened trapping data
figure_specs.format: PDF/SVG vector for diagnostics; 600-dpi raster if heatmap
figure_specs.quality_requirements: show trap effort, counts, uncertainty, and missing effort diagnostics before any abundance surface

figure_specs.caption_must_state: aggregate public surveillance only; not individual risk or intervention effect
figure_specs.quality_requirements: privacy-safe aggregation, denominator/exposure note, case definition, reporting period, suppressed cells retained

figure_specs.caption_must_state: formal Rt only if disease-specific time-series and interval assumptions pass gates
figure_specs.quality_requirements: median and uncertainty intervals, incidence panel, delay/interval sensitivity, date axis and reporting caveats

figure_specs.caption_must_state: schematic/protocol unless real joined data and bias review pass
figure_specs.quality_requirements: show source boundaries, join keys, temporal windows, bias checks, and blocked/unblocked gate states

figure_specs.caption_must_state: host-switch inference requires sequence-body QC and phylogenetic uncertainty propagation
figure_specs.format: PDF/SVG vector plus publication-resolution tree export
figure_specs.quality_requirements: segment labels, support values, host metadata uncertainty, outgroup/taxonomy note, sequence accession provenance

guardrails: this plan does not execute advanced models or generate advanced scientific figures
all model modules remain blocked until their required data, schema, bias, and protocol gates pass
publication-quality means export/specification quality, not permission to overstate unsupported claims

model_modules.allowed_model_family: presence-background suitability or explicitly scoped risk model after outcome approval
model_modules.blocked_if_missing: environmental covariates, target outcome, bias design, or approved analysis scope
model_modules.required_inputs: approved target outcome, environmental covariates, background/negative design, CRS/resolution/time alignment
model_modules.required_qc: covariate missingness, spatial block validation, sampling-bias diagnostics, sensitivity to background choice

model_modules.allowed_model_family: abundance or detection/occupancy model only after effort fields pass screening
model_modules.blocked_if_missing: trap effort or count fields; GBIF occurrence density alone is insufficient
model_modules.required_inputs: trap nights or effort, species counts/captures, dates, locations/admin units, survey design metadata
model_modules.required_qc: effort completeness, repeated-session structure, detection heterogeneity, location disclosure review

model_modules.allowed_model_family: aggregate descriptive case maps first; no individual-level inference
model_modules.required_inputs: HFRS/HCPS case counts, case definition, geography, reporting period, privacy suppression rule
model_modules.required_qc: case-definition harmonization, privacy suppression, denominator/exposure policy, duplicate reporting review

model_modules.allowed_model_family: formal Rt model only after disease-specific transmission scope is approved
model_modules.blocked_if_missing: subannual incidence time series or approved transmission model scope
model_modules.required_inputs: disease-specific incidence time series, reporting delay policy, serial/generation interval source, right truncation policy
model_modules.required_qc: minimum counts, temporal resolution, censoring, delay sensitivity, interval sensitivity

model_modules.allowed_model_family: designed cross-source association only after join approval; no post-hoc fishing
model_modules.blocked_if_missing: approved join protocol and bias review
model_modules.required_inputs: pre-specified spatial join keys, temporal windows, GBIF/GenBank/surveillance/environment alignment, bias review
model_modules.required_qc: join duplication, missingness, modifiable areal unit sensitivity, temporal alignment sensitivity, bias-risk rating

model_modules.allowed_model_family: phylogenetic/trait-transition analysis only after segment-specific design and uncertainty plan
model_modules.blocked_if_missing: sequence bodies, taxonomy review, or phylogenetic design
model_modules.required_inputs: sequence bodies, segment identity, host/location/date metadata, taxonomy review, alignment, recombination/reassortment screen
model_modules.required_qc: alignment quality, partial/duplicate exclusion, lab-strain flagging, segment consistency, posterior/bootstrap uncertainty

publication_quality_requirements.captions: must include data provenance, sample sizes, uncertainty, gate status, and claim boundaries
publication_quality_requirements.raster_outputs: 600 dpi TIFF/PNG for raster maps and heatmaps
publication_quality_requirements.reproducibility: all figure data tables, scripts, seeds, and DVC inputs must be tracked before final publication export
publication_quality_requirements.vector_outputs: SVG/PDF for maps, diagrams, diagnostics, and tree panels where possible
publication_quality_requirements.visual_style: colorblind-safe palettes, consistent typography, legible legends, panel labels, and journal-safe line weights
